{{Quote|There are two of them. The younger is called Captain Starslay&hellip;no&hellip;Captain Starkill, that's it. The senior officer is Hal Razor. A pompous jay if I ever laid my eyes on one, but, from what I gather, a very capable soldier. If anyone has those pieces, it will be those two.|Pletus Croix, to a spacer|<ref name="TOW" />}}
'''Relgon Starkill''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Starkill served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] for the [[Razor Runners]], a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] which occupied the [[Smoking Forest/Legends|Smoking Forest]], a region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] filled with [[Tree/Legends|tree-like]] rock chimneys. Relgon Starkill was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent by the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Pletus Croix]], who wished to recover two pieces of an ancient [[Glyph of Mustafar that Changed|glyph]] that was taken by the Razor Runners.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Astounding. This shows the moon as a once-rich, lush world. And this obviously shows the aftermath of some sort of cataclysmic event. Where is the third glyph? The one that should show us what happened."<br />"It has been defaced. It is missing entire sections."<br />"What! When I made my initial survey, I know all three were intact and in good condition. That means the Coyn must have removed those missing sections. I hate to ask you this, but&hellip;but this discovery is simply too important. I need you to recover the pieces from them. I can pay you.|Pletus Croix and a spacer|<ref name="TOW" />}}
Relgon Starkill was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="TOW" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Starkill served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Razor Runners]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group which originated from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coyn]]. The Razor Runners had since relocated to the [[Magma/Legends|lava]] world of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], securing an area of the planet called the [[Smoking Forest/Legends|Smoking Forest]] for its large number of [[Tree/Legends|tree-like]] rock chimneys. Despite occupying the area, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] refused to supply any [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] to clear them out. Left unchecked, the Razor Runners prevented [[Pletus Croix]], a [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]], from studying three altars containing glyphs detailing historical information about Mustafar. The Razor Runners, most likely hired by someone to secure the ruins for [[Currency/Legends|financial gain]], were unwilling to allow strangers such as Croix to conduct his research. The Razor Runners even went so far as to deface one of the ancient [[Glyph of Mustafar that Changed|glyphs]], causing two huge portions of it to go missing. One of the two chunks fell into the possession of Starkill, rendering Croix unable to study it further.<ref name="TOW" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan}}
Pletus Croix, ever determined to learn about Mustafar's past, happened across a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] willing to aid in his pursuit in return for payment. Croix, suspecting that [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officers]] Relgon Starkill and [[Hal Razor]] possessed the two missing pieces, instructed the individual to defeat them and recover the fragments.<ref name="TOW" /> Despite Starkill's skill at ranged combat,<ref name="Complete">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> the captain was bested by the spacer dispatched by Croix, and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during combat. Starkill's [[Senior officer/Legends|senior officer]], Hal Razor, faced a similar fate, and the spacer successfully returned the two missing glyph fragments to Croix for further study. For their part in recovering the fragments, Croix awarded the spacer with [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and a [[DP-23 Rifle]].<ref name="TOW" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Younger than his superior [[Officer/Legends|officer]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Hal Razor, Relgon Starkill had fair skin, [[Color/Legends|blond]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and brown-colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOW" /> He was also skilled at ranged combat.<ref name="Complete" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|It is obvious that the mercenaries were targeting these on purpose. I would wager everything I own that their commanding officers have the missing pieces. You will have to defeat them and recover the pieces.|Pletus Croix, to a spacer|<ref name="TOW" />}}
During his time with the Razor Runners, Relgon Starkill wore red [[bounty hunter armor]], a type of assault [[Armor/Legends|armor]] typically worn by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. He also wore a type of tactical [[Goggles/Legends|goggle]] over his left eye, a mechanical monocle<ref name="TOW" /> which closely resembled the [[Novaless Soni-Optics/Legends|Novaless Soni-Optics]] [[Goggles Mark V]].<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> Starkill was armed with multiple [[Rifle/Legends|rifles]], including a [[T-21 light repeating blaster/Legends|T-21 light repeating blaster]], an [[Sg-82 sonic rifle]], and an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]]. Secondary weapons included a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]], [[survival knife]], and [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. At the time of his death he also possessed an assault armor chest plate known as [[Coyn's Protector]], which resembled that of [[composite armor]], and a [[Magnetite/Legends|magnetite]] [[Talking magnetite cleaner/Legends|cleaner]].<ref name="TOW" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|On second thought, I am going to stay away from the Coyn."<br />"That is probably for the best. I will just have to wait for them to leave and then see if I can find anything out from the scrapes they leave behind.|Pletus Croix, to players who decided to abandon the quest|<ref name="TOW" />}}
[[W:c:swg:Captain Relgon Starkill|Relgon Starkill]] was a non-player character in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]'', a [[2005]] [[W:c:swg:Expansion|expansion pack]]<ref name="TOW" /> to [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Starkill was featured in a [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] titled "[[W:c:swg:Unlocking the Secrets|Unlocking the Secrets]]," in which players were tasked by the historian Pletus Croix to kill Relgon Starkill and [[W:c:swg:Commander Hal Razor|Hal Razor]] in order to recover glyph fragments. Completing these objectives awarded the player 10,000 [[W:c:swg:Imperial Credit|credits]] and a DP-23 Rifle. Players who [[W:c:swg:Loot|looted]] Starkill's corpse could also find Coyn's Protector [[W:c:swg:Assault armor|assault]] [[W:c:swg:Armor|armor]] and a [[W:c:swg:Dimly Glowing Magnatite Cleaner|dimly glowing magnatite cleaner]], an [[W:c:swg:Chu-Gon Dar Cube glowing item|item]] which could be used in a [[Chu-Gon Dar cube]] to create special [[W:c:swg:Item|items]]. Although the player could choose not to do Croix's quest, this article assumes 100% [[Star Wars video games|game]] completion.<ref name="TOW" />
